value.rationale: Full abstract unit groups are a natural ring invariant. The uniform odd-characteristic collision shows that among equal-dimension, same-residue-field, embedding-dimension-two Gorenstein complete intersections, the abstract unit group cannot recover the Loewy filtration length; the principal unit group even has exponent p squared and is not a trivial elementary-abelian case.
